caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair with a brown leather seat and backrest. The leather on the seat and backrest is fastened with decorative brass or gold-colored tacks or studs along the edges. The backrest has a simple floral or scrollwork design tooled into the leather. The frame of the chair is constructed from dark brown wood, showing visible grain and some signs of wear or aging. The legs are straight, connected by horizontal wooden stretchers on all four sides, with a central stretcher at the front and back having a decorative, scalloped edge. The chair is shown against a plain, light beige or off-white background, with no other objects or distractions present in the composition.
title: Chair
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
